source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the receptors of pain and touch (PDF 45-46).

blocks.text: Jild ke mukhtalif receptors (cutaneous receptors) chhoone (touch), dabao (pressure), garmi, thand aur dard par jawab dete hain.

Nociceptors dard pakarte hain. Dard ko aise stimulus ke taur par bayan kiya gaya hai jo tissue ko nuqsan pohancha raha ho ya pohanchane wala ho. Nociceptors free nerve endings hain jo poore jism mein, khaas taur par sateh ke qareeb, hote hain. Mukhtalif nociceptors shadeed darja-e-hararat, bohat tez dabao ya khaas kimiyai maddon (jin mein zakhmi cells se nikalne wale madde bhi hain) par jawab de sakte hain.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text:
Thermoreceptors sensory neurons ke nange (naked) dendrite sire hain. Yeh darja-e-hararat ka girna aur barhna pakarte hain. Thand ke receptors epidermis ke bilkul neeche hain, jabke garmi ke receptors thora gehre, dermis mein hain.
Thermoreceptors dimagh ke hypothalamus mein bhi hain, jahan yeh khoon ka darja-e-hararat pakar kar jism ke andaruni (core) darja-e-hararat par nazar rakhte hain.
Jild mein kai qisam ke touch receptors hain. Yeh mechanoreceptors (mechanical cheezon jaise dabao aur khinchao ko pehchanne wale) hain jo mukhtalif jismani stimuli par jawab dete hain.

items: Meissner's corpuscles sensory neurons ke sire hain jin ke gird ek capsule (ghilaf) hota hai. Yeh jild ki oopri teh mein hote hain (khaas kar honton, ungliyon ke siron, hatheli aur talwon mein). Yeh halka lams (light touch) aur tharthrahat (vibration) pakarte hain.
Hair follicle receptors neurons ke sire hain jo baalon ki jar (hair follicle) ke gird hote hain. Yeh baalon ki harkat pakarte hain jo mechanical ya garmi wale stimuli se hoti hai.
Merkel cells epidermis ki sab se gehri teh mein bayzavi (oval) receptors hain. Yeh halka lams pakarte hain aur bohat hassas jagahon, jaise ungliyon ke siron, mein hote hain.
Pacinian corpuscles sensory neurons ke sire hain jin ke gird capsule hota hai. Yeh jild mein zyada gehrai par hote hain aur gehra dabao (deep pressure) aur tharthrahat pakarte hain.
Ruffini endings bhi capsule mein band sensory neurons ke sire hain. Yeh dermis mein hote hain aur musalsal dabao aur khinchao (stretching) pakarte hain.

blocks.alt: Jild ka tukra: epidermis, dermis aur charbi ki teh. Baal epidermis se guzar kar apne follicle mein jata hai jis ki jar par hair follicle receptors lipte hain. Free nerve endings epidermis tak pohanchte hain, Merkel cells epidermis ki tah par, Meissner corpuscle dermis ke oopri hisse mein, Ruffini ending dermis mein gehra aur Pacinian corpuscle charbi ki teh mein; sab aik sensory nerve se jure hain.

blocks.long_description: Labels: Free nerve endings (pain, heat, cold), Merkel cells (touch), Hair follicle receptors (touch & movement), Meissner corpuscle (touch), Ruffini endings (pressure & stretching), Pacinian corpuscle (pressure).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har receptor ki gehrai par dhyan dein: free nerve endings sab se oopar epidermis tak (dard, garmi, thand), Merkel cells epidermis ki tah par aur Meissner corpuscle us ke theek neeche (halka lams), hair follicle receptors baal ki jar par (baal hilna), Ruffini endings dermis mein (khinchao aur dabao) aur Pacinian corpuscle sab se gehra charbi mein (gehra dabao).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 15.19 mein "Markel cells" chhapa hai; sahi naam Merkel cells hai (kitab ke apne matan mein bhi Merkel likha hai). Upar ki figure mein sahi naam hai.
Yeh touch receptors impulses bana kar sensory neurons ke zariye spinal cord aur phir dimagh tak bhejte hain, jahan signals process ho kar chhoone ka ehsas banate hain.

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa receptor batata hai ke bhaari kitab haath par dab rahi hai, aur kaun sa ke par (feather) ungli ke sire ko chhoo raha hai?
blocks.explanation: Gehra dabao: Pacinian corpuscles (aur musalsal dabao ke liye Ruffini endings). Ungli ke sire par halka lams: Meissner's corpuscles aur Merkel cells.

items: Nociceptors: dard ke liye free nerve endings. Touch: Meissner's (halka lams, tharthrahat), hair follicle receptors (baal hilna), Merkel cells (halka lams), Pacinian (gehra dabao, tharthrahat), Ruffini (musalsal dabao, khinchao). Thermoreceptors: thand epidermis ke neeche, garmi dermis mein, aur hypothalamus mein.
